newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Luksic group firm Quinenco to issue ADRs.
newsitem.headline: Chile Luksic group firm Quinenco to issue ADRs.

text.p: Chile's Quinenco SA, one of the holding companies for the Luksic industrial group, will issue shares in New York in February via the Amercan Depositary Receipt mechanism, said officials.
The issue will be equivalent to up to 17 percent of the capital of Quinenco, said the firm's general manager Fernando Silva.
Silva declined to say how much the firm hoped to raise or how it would invest the funds.
The company will initially only trade in New York and will not issue shares on the Santiago bourse as its stock is not yet eligible for investment by Chile's cash-rich pension funds, he said.
Quinenco controls the Luksic group's shareholding in industrial companies including copper products maker Madeco and brewery Compania Cervecerias Unidas.
